top_signals.title: European Stocks Edge Higher as UK Homebuilders Rally, Miners Lag
top_signals.summary: European shares ticked higher on Monday as investors looked past rising bond yields, with UK homebuilders jumping after the government announced a new loan program to help first-time buyers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: London's Bridge Troubles Spread with Waterloo at Risk of Closure
top_signals.summary:
London's Waterloo Bridge faces closure within three years without urgent repairs, deepening concerns over the UK capital's crumbling river crossings. 

Are London's bridges really falling down? Harry Black explains. (Source: Bloomberg)
